scope: All 73 edges currently rendered; no claim that every advisor or historical branch is included.
criterion: A public source must explicitly name the relationship, not merely both people or a coauthored publication.
limitations: Reference-found does not mean independently established historical truth.
Premodern advisor entries may be teaching, disputation or intellectual transmission, not modern doctoral supervision.
Removed Strauch II–Zapf bridge stays excluded because the source identity cannot safely be transferred.
Additional advisors visible in source pages are outside this current-edge audit; the graph is not an exhaustive reconstruction.
